crossRefs.note: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive…
What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I don’t seek my own will, but the…
For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard…
Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I…
Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself…
No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for…
for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from…
I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall…
This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon…

translations.web: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
translations.bsb: I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.
translations.kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
translations.asv: For I spake not from myself; but the Father that sent me, he hath given me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
